title: List Report
description: SAP Fiori List Report with saved views, localStorage persistence, a personalized filter bar, a snapping header, products table and mass-action footer. Sample data inline.

usage.summary: Find and act on business records with saved views, applied filters and a responsive results table.
useWhen: Let users search and filter a business-record collection before taking item or mass actions.
Return to saved filter views when the same search tasks recur.
Keep applied results distinct from draft filters and reveal finalizing actions after row selection.

avoidWhen.when: Inspect or edit one record with categorized details, or keep a list beside its selected detail.
Create an unfamiliar object through 3–8 validated steps and review.
Compose a custom result-page container with DynamicPage, or categorized details for one object with ObjectPage, instead of adapting a complete results floorplan.
Build shared global application framing around the business results page.
Explain an empty or unavailable result and provide recovery actions rather than show available rows.

layout: title: DynamicPageTitle with VariantManagement and snapped filter summary
content: Toolbar with Title and row actions, then DataTable
footer: Bar with Button mass actions (shown on selection)
variations: Replace the inline products and applyState handler with application records and a search service; keep filters separate from applied results.
Adapt columns, row actions and mass actions to the business object; retain stable row keys and selection-driven footer visibility.
Replace localStorageAdapter with a VariantStorage implementation when saved views must persist outside this browser.
